title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Structured rejection for failed tool calls (plan §5.1). Hidden and nonexistent entities return the same externally safe response. INTERNAL_ERROR pauses the match with a diagnostic ID; never serialize stack traces or raw engine objects.

status.description: rejected = terminal failure (correct and resubmit); pending = long engine work still running, poll game.action_result.

message.description: Human/model-readable explanation obeying visibility rules (no hidden-state leakage, e.g. in movement-preview rejection reasons).

actionId.description: Echo of the request actionId when the error is tied to a specific submission.

currentRevision.description: Committed revision the client should re-observe from (present for STALE_STATE).

diagnosticId.description: Log correlation ID for INTERNAL_ERROR (present only for that code).
